arithmetic.method: Exact rational input; common-denominator integer comparisons.

all_partial_efx.definition: All partial EFX allocations, including complete; no charity safety condition.

all_partial_efx_safe.definition: All partial EFX allocations with whole-charity nonenvy, including complete.

at_most_one_charity_efx_safe.definition: EFX and whole-charity nonenvy with zero or one charity good, including complete.

exactly_one_charity_efx_safe.definition: EFX and whole-charity nonenvy with exactly one charity good.

enumeration.tie_break: First base-5 owner-code vector in lexicographic order; charity code is 4.

improvement_comparison: Strict lexicographic utility improvement over the supplied candidate, priority [0,1,2,3]; outside the at-most-one-charity safe domain.

outside_at_most_one_safe_domain.definition: All partial EFX allocations that fail whole-charity nonenvy or have more than one charity good.
